d:
Amerika ne bharat par panch bare aarop lagate hue 25 fisdi tak tairif lagane ka prastav diya hai. halanki, tred dil hone par ise 17 fisdi karne ki bat kahi gaee hai. bharat ne ameriki aaropon ko kharij kiya hai. magar nae tairif ka bharat par kya asar hoga aur jankar kya kah rahe hain?
Aavaz: pavan sinh atul
Editing: sadaf khan
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
